indicators: Inputs (source declarations): port = input(15, title = "Portfolio %", type = input.float, step = 0.1, minval = 0.1, maxval = 100); PositionInputs = input("++++", title = "+++++ Long Positions VA Layers +++++"); ps2 = input(2, title = "2nd Long Entry %", step = 0.1); ps3 = input(3, title = "3rd Long Entry %", step = 0.1); ps4 = input(5, title = "4th Long Entry %", step = 0.1); ps5 = input(10, title = "5th Long Entry %", step = 0.1); ps6 = input(16, title = "6th Long Entry %", step = 0.1); maInput = input("++++", title = "+++++ Moving Average Filter +++++"); plotMA = input(title = "Plot Moving Average", defval = false); movingaverage_signal = sma(close, input(100)); rsiInput = input( "++++", title = "+++++ RSI Inputs +++++" ); length = input( 14 ); overSold = input( 30, title = "oversold, entry trigger long position" ); overBought = input( 70, title = "overbought, has no specific function"); takeprofit = input("++++", title = "+++++ Take Profit +++++"); ProfitTarget_Percent = input(5, title = "Take Profit % (Per Position)"); ProfitTarget_Percent_All = input(7, title = "Take Profit % (Exit All, above % of price average, white line)"); dcaWeek = input("++++", title = "+++++ Open DCA order once every week +++++") | Indicator calls: sma(close, input(100); rsi(price, length)
entry_long: Source rule: (co with all conditions true strategy.opentrades  equals  0); Source rule: (strategy.opentrades  equals  1); Source rule: (strategy.opentrades  equals  2); Source rule: (strategy.opentrades  equals  3); Source rule: (strategy.opentrades  equals  4); Source rule: (strategy.opentrades  equals  5); Source rule: (dcatime with all conditions true newWeek with all conditions true strategy.position_size  exceeds  0 with all conditions true close  is below  strategy.position_avg_price)

filters: Only conditions present in the cited source are represented in entry rules; no external filters added.
